Vue Composition API Plugin: app.description:
Requires the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin (Vue 2.6 and below).
`createApp` here is the plugin's deprecated Vue 3-style shim — on Vue 2.7+ drop the plugin and use `new Vue({ el, render })` instead.
`Vue.use(VueCompositionAPI)` must run before any Composition API call.
